name: PETG-GF

guidance.text: Holders, brackets and general functional parts; favourable interlayer bonding.
Glossy appearance and low warping; fine detail and support release are less favourable than PLA.
Use a release layer where recommended to protect smooth PEI. Strong self-support adhesion complicates removal.
Tune cooling and retraction for stringing and detail; cooling can trade against interlayer bonding.

summary.text: PETG-GF is a glass-fibre-filled PETG copolyester. Makers sell it for structural components and outdoor parts, and stress its dimensional stability and low warping. Its glass transition is 75 °C. On the H2C it prints at 250⁠–⁠270 °C, but makers call for a hardened steel or reinforced nozzle.

items.text: iSANMATE PETG Glass Fiber filament combines strength and precision, ideal for demanding 3D printing projects.
High rigidity and excellent toughness
Excellent heat resistance and short processing cycle
Excellent hydrolysis resistance and product stability
High strength: The addition of glass fiber significantly improves the mechanical strength of PETG, making it more suitable for load-bearing or functional parts.
High rigidity: Glass fiber enhances the rigidity of the material and reduces the risk of deformation of the printed parts.
Chemical resistance: PETG itself has good chemical resistance, and the addition of glass fiber further enhances its corrosion resistance.
Enhanced wear resistance: The addition of glass fiber improves the wear resistance of the material and extends the service life of the print.
Shows 80% PETG matrix with 20% glass fiber for enhanced strength.
Details glass fiber PETG’s ability to withstand up to 85°C for industrial uses.

Showcases iSANMATE PETG Glass Fiber Filament’s mechanical strengths (toughness, strength, resistance), environmental resistances (abrasion, chemical, drop), and printing – friendly quality (neat winding, smooth extrusion, precise diameter) for reliable 3D prints.
Highlights firm bed adhesion, stable base, and no warping during printing.

items.text: It is particularly suitable for manufacturing structural components or outdoor models that require high impact resistance and durability against drops.
ERYONE PETG-GF filament is an enhanced PETG material that offers excellent flow properties and ease of printing, along with low odor and outstanding chemical resistance.
Parts printed with this material are not only strong and durable but also exhibit excellent dimensional stability
featuring a fine matte and frosted texture on the surface.

items.text: By combining glass fibres, anti-UV additives and PETG, natively waterproof and resistant to temperatures up to 80 °C, Nanovia PETG GF UV is the perfect filament for parts subjected to outdoor conditions.
This filament is also suitable for electrical applications, The glass fibres do not conduct electricity, unlike Nanovia PETG CF ’s carbon fibres.
GPS beacon housings in PETG GF UV
Easy to print
Nanovia PETG GF UV doesn’t require a 3D printer with a closed/heated enclosure, unlike ASA.
It’s two times as rigid and 40 % more resistant compared to native PETG filament.
The product is not approved for medical applications.
items.conditions: Own SDS exclusion. No clinical/implant suitability inferred from application marketing, processing advice or another product.

items.text: This ease of printing is made possible by the addition of glass fibres which strongly reduce the warping of the polymer during the 3D printing process.
A reinforced nozzle, suitable for abrasive materials is recommended.
